title: How a Meal Rung on an Employee Meal Account Is Met at the Counter
content:
A meal rung on an Employee Meal Account is met from the tenders the plan allows, and where more than one is available they are taken in a fixed order: employer allowance first, then stored value, then payroll.

## Ceilings at the till

A till transaction may not exceed the single transaction ceiling printed against the plan, and the account may not spend more across all tenders in one service day than the daily ceiling printed against the same plan; a meal that would breach either is rung for the part that fits and the rest is taken in cash or on the employee's own card.

## The state the account must stand in

A meal is only rung while the account stands active or restricted; a restricted account may still spend stored value and allowance but may not tender against payroll, and an enrolled, parked or closed account is declined at the till. The account's own record settles this before the meal is rung, read by the account's reference together with the stored value and unspent allowance standing on it.

## Short stored value

Where stored value is short, the plan's overdraft limit carries the transaction down to that limit and the overdraft charge printed against the plan is raised; a plan whose overdraft limit is zero declines the transaction instead. No more overdraft charges are raised in a calendar month than the count printed against the plan, and once that count is reached further short transactions are declined rather than charged.

## Guest meals and outlets outside the allowance scope

A guest meal is only rung on a plan that allows guest meals, carries the guest surcharge printed against the plan, and counts against the monthly guest meal allowance printed against the same plan; the guest surcharge is never met from employer allowance.

A meal rung at an outlet outside the plan's allowance scope is still rung, but is met from stored value or payroll alone, since allowance does not travel outside the outlets the employer funds.

## Truth table on the account's state

| Account state | Allowance and stored value | Payroll tender |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Spendable | Available where the plan enables it |
| Restricted | Spendable | Withdrawn |
| Enrolled | Declined at the till | Declined at the till |
| Parked for leave | Declined at the till | Declined at the till |
| Closed | Declined at the till | Declined at the till |
